==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I explored the library of the Magic Hero Academy. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Magic Hero Library resembles a large room of yellow stone, full of tall glittering blue book shelves, and rectangular glowing blue sitting tables.)
I spent a lot of time reading a book about portal mechanics and pocket dimensions.
I discovered a simulator in the library that can be used to help teach concepts through immersion. (The Magic Hero Simulator resembles a silver hooded dryer chair.)
